# jumpcloud_scheduled_report (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud scheduled report.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_scheduled_report" "weekly_compliance" {
  display_name       = "Weekly Compliance Report"
  description        = "Automated weekly compliance summary"
  schedule_frequency = "weekly"
  schedule_time      = "09:00 AM"
  time_zone          = "America/New_York"
  days               = ["MONDAY"]
  is_active          = true
  export_type        = "csv"
  report_id          = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
  report_type        = "report_view"

  recipients {
    channel_type = "email"
    value        = ["compliance@example.com", "security@example.com"]
  }

  recipients {
    channel_type = "slack"
    value        = ["#compliance-reports"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the scheduled report.
- `schedule_frequency` (String) How often the report runs: daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly.

### Optional

- `days` (List of String) Days to run the report. For weekly: day names (MONDAY, TUESDAY, etc). For monthly/quarterly: FIRST_DAY or LAST_DAY.
- `description` (String) Description of the scheduled report.
- `end_date` (String) End date for the schedule (ISO 8601 format).
- `export_type` (String) Export format: csv or json.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the scheduled report is active.
- `recipients` (Attributes List) Notification recipients for the report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recipients))
- `report_id` (String) The ID of the report view or template to run.
- `report_type` (String) Type of report: report_view or report_template.
- `schedule_time` (String) Time of day to run the report (e.g. '09:00 AM').
- `start_date` (String) Start date for the schedule (ISO 8601 format).
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone for the schedule (e.g. 'America/New_York').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the scheduled report.

<a id="nestedatt--recipients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recipients`

Required:

- `channel_type` (String) Channel type: email, slack, or webhook.
- `value` (List of String) List of recipient addresses (emails, Slack channels, or webhook URLs).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_scheduled_report.example <report-id>
```
